coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: P24
names: P24 -- waterfront lawn (Bayfront Park approach, south of 499 Illinois St)
record.summary: A triangular waterfront lawn with a curved path south of 499 Illinois Street, visually resembling Bayfront Park's own style and possibly a continuation of it; real landscaped open land per satellite imagery, delineated by this project's owner-directed real-gap-fragment method rather than a surveyed parcel boundary. OCII's own September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P24' among the parcels already managed by the Port of San Francisco (not among the still-pending 'when built' parcels), consistent with it being complete by that date. Name and specific operator not confirmed by any source found.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- real landscaped open land (lawn, curved path, scattered trees) per Esri satellite imagery and the street/already-tracked-polygon-bounded gap computation, cut at an owner-directed cross-sectional fork point rather than a surveyed parcel boundary. Name and operator not confirmed by any source found in this pass; visually resembles Bayfront Park's own style and may be a continuation of it.
notes.digitized_from: Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) around the 499 Illinois St / Bayfront Park area (fragment 2, 19,181.78 sqm raw). The owner reviewed a 3-way width-scan split of that fragment (at its two real cross-sectional waists, lat 37.7658 and 37.76665) and then directed the same fork-cut technique used for P26: keep the wide single-segment 'head', drop the thin multi-segment 'horns'.

milestones.text: Already part of the Port of San Francisco's managed open-space inventory (not listed among the still-pending 'when built' parcels), per OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the Mission Bay CAC -- an upper bound on when this lawn was built, not its actual construction date

open_questions: No source names this specific lawn or gives its own construction date; the Sept 2023 OCII document only establishes it existed and was already Port-managed by that date, which is an upper bound, not a build date.

Not confirmed whether this lawn was built as part of Bayfront Park's own 2024 construction (which it visually resembles and adjoins) or earlier, as part of 409/499 Illinois Street's 2008 completion (whose developer's own project page describes 'nearly an acre of waterfront outdoor space' at that building, per src-sksre-409-499illinois) -- no source ties this specific parcel's completion to either project, so no more specific date is asserted.

Whether OCII's own current numbering scheme still uses 'P24' for exactly this footprint was not independently confirmed -- OCII's current public Mission Bay South open-space page (sfocii.org/projects/mission-bay-south/open-space) does not list a P24 at all among the parcels it names (P1, P2, P3, P5, P6, P26).
